operators.name: custom_max_dim1_keepdim
semantics: Corresponds to torch.max(x, dim=1, keepdim=True) from reference.
Reduces over dimension 1 with keepdim=True, output shape same as input but dim 1 size 1.
Returns tuple (values float32, indices int64) exactly as torch.max result.
Index values are int64 and select the channel index of maximum for each spatial location.
The max operation compares float values, indices record first occurrence of maximum if ties, matching PyTorch behavior.

operators.name: custom_layer_norm
semantics: Corresponds to nn.LayerNorm(num_channels) applied to x of shape [N,1,H,W] with normalized_shape [64] (last dimension).
Computes mean and variance over the last dimension (64) for each sample (N,1,H locations).
Output y = (x - mean) / sqrt(var + eps) * weight + bias, with weight/bias broadcast along last dim.
Uses default elementwise_affine=True, so weight and bias are applied.
Non-trainable? In reference self.layer_norm has weight and bias parameters, both trainable, but in eval mode used as-is.
Performs max reduction over channel dimension 1, keepdim=True producing values and indices.
Output values dtype float32, indices dtype int64, both shape [512,1,1024,64] on CUDA.
The tuple is unpacked and indices discarded in original, but debug_forward should yield the full tuple.
Applies LayerNorm over last dimension (64) to tensor x of shape [512,1,1024,64] using weight and bias of shape [64].
Returns the normalized tensor, identical to step_002 value.
